# Amlin

> Amlin is a macOS app that combines an AI meeting notepad, system-wide voice dictation, and a self-filling to-do list. No bot joins your calls: Amlin captures system audio at the operating-system level on your own Mac, transcribes it live, and turns your rough notes into a structured summary the moment the meeting ends. Meeting audio is never stored; dictation runs entirely on-device.

Key facts (checked August 2026):

- Platform: macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon. No Windows, iOS, or Android app.
- Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and anything else that plays sound on the Mac. No bot joins the call; other participants install nothing.
- Meeting audio is streamed for live transcription and discarded immediately. It is never written to disk or stored by Amlin. Only notes and transcript text remain.
- Dictation works in any app (hold a key, speak, get cleaned-up text) and runs entirely on-device. It is included in the free plan and never metered.
- Action items are extracted from meetings with owners and due dates into one list across all meetings.
- Ask lets users chat over one meeting or their whole history, with citations to the source line.
- Google Calendar integration is optional and read-only.
- Pricing: Free plan with 4 meeting-hours per month, full note history, and unmetered dictation. Pro is $10/month or $108/year with 40 meeting-hours per month and unlimited Ask queries. Prices in USD; cancel anytime.
- Sign in with Google. Made by Amlin Labs LLC.
